value.rationale: Beyond a bound on iterations, this classifies all possible global support-update transition tables for a natural finite family derived from one initially S5 model. It distinguishes the full modal, positive diamond and propositional fragments by exact structural semigroups and counts, proves simultaneous realizability from any support and exhibits a longest possible orbit in the positive fragment. This gives a meaningful complete dynamical expressivity result and a testable benchmark, not an isolated small-instance count; the matching known combinatorial factors are not themselves asserted new.
